title: Inzwi Rakadana Kukururama
intro: Munyika yekare yeMidhiani, uko kutengeserana kwaibudirira uye mapoka evafambi aifamba nemumarenje makuru, muporofita waAllah akasimuka pakati pevanhu vakanga vatsauka munzira yeruramisiro. Muranda waAllah uyu akatumwa nebasa raMwari raizoedza kutenda kwenharaunda yese. Kuburikidza nemiedzo yekutsungirira nekutsungirira, mweya uyu wakamira wakasimba mukupa yambiro yaizodzokorora nhoroondo. Unogona here kutsanangura chakavanzika chemutumwa uyu akasimba?
clues: Ndakasarudzwa naAllah kuti nditungamirire vanhu vakanga vakanganwa misimboti yekururamisira nekuvimbika mumabasa avo.
Ndakapa meseji ndichikurudzira nharaunda yangu kuti inamate Allah chete uye kuti itaure chokwadi pazvinhu zvese.
Ndakanyevera zvakananga nezvetsika yehuori yekushandisa pfuma nenzira dzisiri pamutemo uye ndakasimbisa kukosha kwezviyero nezviyero zvakarurama.
Vanhu vangu vakapindura yambiro dzangu vachindiseka, vachindityisidzira kuti vaizondidzinga munyika yavo kana ndikaramba ndichiparidza.
Ndakaramba ndakashinga mubasa rangu pasinei neruvengo rwavo, ndichiti mubairo wangu uri kuna Allah chete.
Vanhu vangu vakabatwa nechirango chinoparadza asi ini ndakaponeswa netsitsi dzaIshe wangu, basa rangu parakanga razadziswa.
